sdlc.name: FINOS SDLC Common Controls Catalog
sdlc.note: Pre-alpha catalog; each risk and mitigation carries its own version and status. Ids are SDLC-TYPE-NNN.

controls.name: Deployment gating
controls.risk: Unreviewed or failing software reaches main or is released.
controls.operates: Branch protection on main requires the gate, security-fast, test-integrity and DCO checks (strict), one approving review from the independent reviewer identity after the last push, and applies to admins. release.yml re-runs the gate and checks ancestry and version before publishing.

controls.name: Agent least privilege
controls.risk: An agent changes protections, reads secrets or lands code outside its authority.
controls.operates: Agents run with a fine-grained token scoped to this repository without administration, secrets, workflow or environment rights; GitHub refuses the rest. The Gibson repo-boundary guard refuses commits that leave the repository or touch gate configuration. Branch protection refuses direct pushes to main for every credential.
verify: follow evidence/README.md, section Reproduce P2: every attempt must be refused

controls.name: Human release approval
controls.risk: An agent-built artefact is published without a named human accepting it.
controls.operates: The publish job of release.yml runs in the `release` environment, which needs approval by a named human before any asset is uploaded. The approval is recorded in release-evidence.json.

controls.name: Independent review
controls.risk: An agent's change is approved by the same vendor or identity that wrote it.
controls.operates: The review lane publishes a verdict as the reviewer identity only for a PR whose commits each declare one Agent-Vendor, and always picks a reviewer of a different vendor. Branch protection requires that approval at the latest head.
evidence: review verdicts on each merged PR

controls.name: Test integrity and execution
controls.risk: A change passes the gate by deleting, skipping or weakening tests.
controls.operates: The test-integrity job grades the PR against the merge-base copy of scripts/test-integrity.mjs and fails on deleted or skipped tests; the gate job runs typecheck, lint, test and build.
verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
evidence: closed canary PRs #7 (deleted test), #8 (skipped test), #9 (failing test)

controls.name: Artefact provenance
controls.risk: A released artefact cannot be tied to the pipeline run and approval that produced it.
controls.operates: release.yml signs a build attestation bound to the tarball sha256 and publishes SHA256SUMS and release-evidence.json naming the artefact by digest.

controls.name: Released artefact re-verification
controls.risk: A released artefact or its records are replaced after release.
controls.operates: A separate scheduled workflow downloads every published release, recomputes sha256 against SHA256SUMS and release-evidence.json, verifies the attestation is from release.yml on the release tag, fails an empty published release, and opens a control-finding issue on any mismatch.

controls.name: Delivery process audit
controls.risk: A change reaches main without the independent approval, green checks, sign-off or agent identity the policy requires, or branch protection drifts.
controls.operates: A scheduled workflow re-checks, from GitHub's records, every PR merged since the baseline (approval at the exact head, required checks, DCO, one Agent-Vendor per commit, reviewer vendor differs), the live branch protection against .gibson-delivery.json, and direct pushes. It writes JSONL evidence, files one control-finding per violation, and honours only exact, reviewed waivers.

controls.name: Audit evidence query
controls.risk: An independent party cannot establish from records who changed what, who approved it and which checks it passed.
controls.operates: audit-query reads only the retained evidence files (no network, no git) and answers, for a commit or release tag, which agent or vendor acted, who approved, which checks passed, which artefact was released and whether it was re-verified, reporting 'no evidence' rather than guessing.
evidence: its JSON output for a given commit or tag

label_notes.label: OP-007
label_notes.note: Not an id in the FINOS SDLC catalog or the AI Governance Framework; a local label for monitoring.

label_notes.label: MI-4
label_notes.note: Used for the Agent-Vendor trailer and vendor-separation checks. FINOS MI-4 is AI System Observability; the checks fit SDLC-PREV-023 (Agentic Processes Provenance) and SDLC-PREV-001 (Code Review) better.

label_notes.label: MI-21
label_notes.note: Used for the DCO sign-off check. FINOS MI-21 is Agent Decision Audit and Explainability, which fits the evidence trail but not sign-off.

label_notes.label: RC-005
label_notes.note: Used as a control id for the required-checks-green check. SDLC-RC-005 is the risk Audit and Compliance Evidence Failure; the matching mitigations are SDLC-PREV-012 and SDLC-PREV-016.

label_notes.label: SDLC-SEC-008
label_notes.note: Used as a control id for approval, merged-via-PR, protection and direct-push checks. It is the risk Unauthorised Change; the matching mitigations are SDLC-PREV-001 and SDLC-PREV-012.
